purpose: One final candidate for this pass; freeze before fresh validation. No more architecture changes after selection.
selection_rule: Use passer-qking only if the completed 96-game passer screen beats the current candidate by at least 0.04 matched point score and has nonnegative matched GNU difference; otherwise use qking. King caching and early quiescence stand-pat preserve fixed-depth search in 204+6 positions.
primary_gate: Candidate vs published baseline matched mean point-score difference has approximate 95 percent lower bound above zero
Skill5 improvement positive and GNU matched difference nonnegative
No candidate technical failures, finite correctness, protocol, history, mate and sanitizer checks pass
Exact final binary completes 180+2 and 600+5 simulations without own clock/protocol failure
phase1_comparison: Secondary descriptive control comparison; do not call superiority over phase1 established from a tiny/noisy difference. Prefer the already-qualified phase1 build if final candidate has lower matched point score than phase1 control.
fallback: If neither candidate clears its declared external-field gate, retain current production; publish experiments and report that no strength improvement was established rather than invent a successful release.
